title: Qualitative Faraday-Zusammenhänge abrufen
description: Die lernende Person kann die bereits erlernten qualitativen Faraday-Zusammenhänge zwischen relevanter Ladung, Elektronenbedarf, Stoffmenge und Masse sowie ihre Beschränkung auf die festgelegte Elektrodenreaktion und Stromausbeute mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the previously taught qualitative Faraday relationships between reaction-specific charge, electron requirement, amount and mass, including their limitation to the specified electrode reaction and current efficiency, using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact verbal laws only; no numerical formula/value obligation, no ordinary mastery or practical-performance certification.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Only the goal: tag remains after actual getSrsFilterTags; FlashcardDrill uses OR-intersection with card.tags. No GK/LK selector is added, so legacy quantitative card008 cannot match.

actualAdditionalAcquisitionScope.basis: The new qualitative ordinary is also an explicit prerequisite target in nine valid quantitative courses; recall follows that learned qualitative origin. HE-GK is excluded explicitly in the HE view, and no quantitative HE law obligation is introduced.
actualAdditionalAcquisitionScope.candidateMemoryReviewOriginBinding: New positive qualitative M row is required in the prospective436 selector, with independent review pending.
